summary: Slide each lower red vertical bar upward in its column until it touches the blue shape above.
dst: column slot immediately below the lowest blue pixel in s.column
path: slide s upward within its column until its top pixel is just below the lowest blue pixel in that column
trajectory: move the whole bar as a vertical red segment, preserving height and column
transform: erase each source bar from its original lower position; keep blue pixels and background unchanged
